evals.name: normal_multi_page_exam_outputs
evals.input: multi-page exam with stable footer page numbers
assertions: writes formal original PNGs without watermark
writes formal erased PNGs without watermark
writes original and erased Word with identical page count
writes regions JSON, consensus JSON, audit NDJSON, report, and run.json

evals.name: page_number_touching_body_falls_back
evals.input: page number close to body text safety margin
assertions: formal erased PNG is an unwatermarked original copy
manual review preview contains red mark
erased Word uses manual preview for that page

evals.name: rotated_or_two_page_exam_keeps_protocol
assertions: falls back to manual_review when safety is uncertain
does not call any baseline VLM
